terms.gloss: look at the clock or watch

phrases.latin: dōnec avia, hōrologiō īnspectō, eum revocāvit: «Domum! Prandium parandum est.»
phrases.english: until Grandma looked at her watch and called him back: “Home! Lunch has to be made.”
phrases.source: Libellus III, Apud avum et aviam

sources: John C. Traupman, Conversational Latin for Oral Proficiency: pp. 89, 122, checked against the searchable text of the book on 29 October 2026.

Theodōrus et pater · Ad Larem avītum, Libellī I–VII, as they stood on 7 November 2026, with their glosses. Examples marked “Libellus” quote those texts word for word; classical passages are cited by author.
